summary: Pearson plc filed a Form 6-K confirming that Non-Executive Director Annette Thomas ceased to be a Non-Executive Director of Schroders plc effective 1 October 2026, following Schroders' acquisition by Pantheon LLC on the same date. The notification is made under UKLR 6.4.9R and concerns only an external directorship of a Pearson board member, not any transaction by Pearson. No terms, consideration, board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock are stated. No special-situation event for Pearson; watch for unrelated Pearson board or governance disclosures.
